Kenney RPG Base
Official source: https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-base
Direct zip: https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/rpg-base/316dd80b01-1677669634/kenney_rpg-base.zip
License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 (see license.txt). Credit to Kenney (www.kenney.nl) is appreciated, not required.

This folder is the unpacked official pack. Gameplay scripts must not reference these files by path.
Client visual IDs in res://content/visual_map.json map to textures here.

Manual reinstall
1. Download the zip from the official source above.
2. Extract so license.txt, PNG/, Spritesheet/, and Vector/ sit in this directory.
3. Run Godot import on client/.
